```{r}
# Assumes etfs, mutualfunds, and tidyverse are already loaded.
# bind_rows keeps columns unique to either dataset and fills the other rows with NA.
funds <- bind_rows(
  etfs %>% mutate(etf_indicator = 1L),
  mutualfunds %>% mutate(etf_indicator = 0L)
)

# Keep fund YTD, 1-year, 2021 quarterly, and the requested YTD price field.
keep_returns <- c(
  "fund_return_ytd", "fund_return_1year", "year_to_date_return",
  paste0("fund_return_2021_q", 1:4)
)
drop_returns <- setdiff(
  grep("return", names(funds), value = TRUE),
  c(keep_returns, "returns_as_of_date")
)

# Remove predictors based on trailing days, weeks, months, or years.
drop_time <- grep(
  paste0(
    "^(avg_vol_|day[0-9]+_moving_average$|week[0-9]+_|",
    "years_(up|down)$|quarters_(up|down)$|",
    "fund_(alpha|beta|r_squared|stdev|sharpe_ratio|treynor_ratio)_[0-9]+years$|",
    "(fund|category)_year[0-9]+_|annual_holdings_turnover$)"
  ),
  names(funds), value = TRUE
)

funds <- funds %>%
  # These columns are constant or duplicate the ETF indicator.
  select(-currency, -region, -exchange_timezone,
         -fund_bonds_us_government, -quote_type,
         -all_of(drop_returns), -all_of(drop_time)) %>%
  mutate(inception_date = as.Date(inception_date)) %>%
  filter(inception_date < as.Date("2021-01-01")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Shared three-group score for comparing ETFs with mutual funds.
    diversification_broad = 1 - (
      asset_stocks^2 + asset_bonds^2 +
        (1 - asset_stocks - asset_bonds)^2
    ),
    # All six weights are reported only for mutual funds; ETF scores are NA.
    diversification = 1 - (
      asset_cash^2 + asset_stocks^2 + asset_bonds^2 +
        asset_others^2 + asset_preferred^2 + asset_convertible^2
    )
  )

```

```{r}

# lm drops rows missing a variable in this formula, not rows missing other columns.
# year_to_date_return stays in funds but nearly duplicates fund_return_ytd.
model <- lm(
  fund_return_ytd ~ total_net_assets + diversification_broad +
    fund_price_earning_ratio + fund_sector_technology +
    fund_annual_report_net_expense_ratio * etf_indicator,
  data = funds
)

model_data <- model.frame(model)
table(funds$etf_indicator)
table(model_data$etf_indicator)
summary(model)
```
